reference_materials: Manufacturer catalogue PDF page 5 and native tube photograph inspected locally; images are not redistributed.
findings: Eight final container views inspected: capped front/back/oblique, separated cap, nominal stock and nozzle closeups.
Grey tapered body, flattened sealed hanging flange and pale ribbed cap follow the source photograph. Dimensions and local shape are reconstruction hypotheses.
The nozzle view hides nominal contents and crops the upper tube to expose its bore. This is reviewer visibility, not material consumption.
The nominal 85 g stock fits within the hollow tube under the stated approximate density. Selected 0.25 mm visualization clearance prevents exported mesh intersections.
One capped tube rests on its actual cap base in the laboratory composition. Inspection views create no additional stock.
The cleanup inspector link was added; all eight re-rendered container captures remain byte-identical to the preceding inspected release.
geometry_limits: No official CAD or measured package dimensions. Original identification text differs from manufacturer artwork.
Thread engagement, sealing, squeezing, dispensing, lubrication and robot manipulation are unqualified.

Inferred 2 g application reservation is not a manufacturer dose. Separate silicone grease, two ordinary assigned spatulas and a shared 300-wipe pack are now selected in the downstream inventory. Actual application, waste transfer and full trial/reset budgets remain open.
